verdict.rationale: Keyboard-driven operation and interface speed are fair axes for an email client like Outlook, but the evidence pack has no documentation of keyboard shortcuts or a command palette; the first-party docs cover only the Graph mail API. Community reports on speed are mixed, with one noting the web app loads in under a second and several describing slow or unresponsive behavior in new and classic Outlook. With no documented capability for the core of the story, the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can do everything from the keyboard — comprehensive shortcuts and a command palette — in an interface fast enough to never make me wait
